events.title: Sessions Surf Festival
events.description: A week-long surf culture festival blending surf film screenings, live music, art exhibitions, board shaper demonstrations, and community gatherings across various Gold Coast beaches and venues. Includes talks and ocean-focused activations alongside surf competitions.

events.title: Inside Pompeii: Origins of a European Way of Life
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise/Southport
events.description: A major museum-style exhibition at HOTA exploring daily life in ancient Pompeii through authentic artefacts, immersive displays, and interpretive media, ideal for history and archaeology enthusiasts.

events.title: Aka Sorbie: Saltwater Heart
events.description: A contemporary art exhibition by Aka Sorbie at HOTA Gallery, featuring paintings and mixed media works that reflect on the ocean, place, and cultural identity with a strong connection to saltwater Country.

events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection of Chinese Contemporary Art
events.description: A survey exhibition at HOTA Gallery showcasing leading Chinese contemporary artists from Sydney’s White Rabbit Collection, featuring large-scale installations, video, and painting examining rapid social change.

events.title: A Bigger View
events.location: Gallery at HOTA precinct, Surfers Paradise/Southport
events.description: A long-running visual arts presentation at HOTA featuring large-format works and installations that offer new perspectives on the Gold Coast landscape and skyline, suitable for casual visitors and art enthusiasts.

events.title: Koi Sunset Sessions
events.location: HOTA Lakeside/Koi dining area, Surfers Paradise/Southport
events.description: Relaxed early evening outdoor sessions by the HOTA lake featuring DJs or live acoustic acts, accompanied by food and drinks, offering a regular spot for locals to unwind at sunset.

events.title: James Alexander's Soul Sundays
events.location: Local live music venue (HOTA or similar), Gold Coast
events.description: A weekly Sunday soul and R&B session led by James Alexander with his band and guest vocalists, offering an intimate, groove-focused gig for fans of neo-soul and classic soul sounds.
